recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless CDS or FHIR-I reopens the R6 EvidenceVariable, Group, or RelativeTime modeling decisions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification CDS R5 change request to add EvidenceVariable.characteristic.timeFromEvent 0..* with description, event, quantity, range, and note children, including an example binding for event to Procedure Codes.
initial_application: The Jira comment identified bac01125124ef5d906e86c9f6d75340772380ce2, which added EvidenceVariable.characteristic.timeFromEvent and its child elements to source/evidencevariable/structuredefinition-EvidenceVariable.xml, including the initial Procedure Codes example binding. Later R5 history refined the shape and descriptions of the element family.
additional_context: EvidenceVariable remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini, but FHIR-42886 was an Applied R6 decision that removed EvidenceVariable.characteristic rather than deprecating it and replaced the model with EvidenceVariable.definition/Group. The current source also defines EvidenceVariable.timing as RelativeTime, and FHIR-41582 created RelativeTime for event-relative timing. source/fhir.ini records the removed timeFromEvent paths under [r5-r6-changes], confirming they are tracked prior-release paths rather than missing current-build elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding EvidenceVariable.characteristic.timeFromEvent would reverse a later final R6 modeling decision, while the current source already carries the relevant event-relative timing concept through current R6 structures.
